summary: The PR addresses the issue of making RenameModel a no-op when db_table is unchanged, but there are some minor concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any additional tests specifically for the case where db_table is unchanged. While the existing tests pass, adding specific tests for this scenario would improve confidence.
There is no update to the docstring or comments to reflect the change in behavior. Adding a note about the no-op condition when db_table is unchanged would improve clarity.
